# Commands console and shared Thunderbird memory system

`CONTRIBUTING.md` requires fetch-before-push, normal merges, no force-push, preserving both contributors' files, and manual review for shared-instruction conflicts. The console imports configured Markdown notes/records, commits eligible new files, and can sync `origin`; GitHub sync stays inactive until `origin` is configured. [Task 1]

Scope: general.
